policy: Replay 8 voices against each of the same 16 kitchen and living-room clock/command cells. Compare original context-0/speed-1 baseline vs training-selected index; equal matched active levels and 200 ms tail. Native C161; integer early research route with prior P4 service P95. Full P4 listener for the highest-ranked training pair only, P4 Opus for each distinct target opening and re-decode. Scenes are repeated development inputs; synthesis settings and top voice selected before this replay.
